caption: שהיא חזקה מכל הערים
en: a strong tall stone fortress with a flag on a high hill under bright sun, no people, no text (Stronger than all cities)

caption: שה' עזב ושכח
en: ruined stone city walls on a dark hill at dusk with one small lantern glowing alone, no people, no text (Forgotten by God)

caption: שאין לה מה לרצות
en: a table in a quiet stone room with an empty plate and a closed window, no people, no text (Nothing to want)

caption: אזכור אותך רק לפעמים
en: a calendar-like wall with only a few small marks on it, no people, no text (I will remember you only sometimes)

caption: לא אשכחך
en: an open palm of a hand with the outline of Jerusalem's stone walls engraved on it, glowing softly, close-up, no text (I will not forget you)

caption: גם אני אשכח
en: a candle burning down to its last drop of wax and going out, no people, no text (I too will forget)

caption: נשאר ריק
en: H: an empty quiet street in a stone city without anyone on it, no text (It stays empty)

caption: צר להם המקום
en: H: a stone city gate packed with many men and boys in ancient clothes coming home happily, a crowd squeezed together, no text (The place is too crowded)

caption: בונים עיר חדשה
en: H: builders in ancient clothes raising a new stone city in a distant valley, men only, no text (They build a new city)

caption: כולם רצו
en: a crowd of men and boys in ancient robes running happily toward a bearded man standing at a city gate, no text (Everyone ran)

caption: אין איש עונה
en: a bearded man in ancient robes standing alone at an open doorway, calling into an empty quiet street at dusk, no text (No one answers)

caption: כולם שרו בשמחה
en: a group of men and boys in ancient robes singing together in a courtyard, no text (Everyone sang joyfully)
